entries.title: Privacy Policy Summary
entries.content: We are committed to protecting your privacy. We collect only the data necessary to provide our services. We do not sell personal data to third parties. All data is encrypted in transit and at rest. You can request data deletion at any time by emailing privacy@example.com. We comply with GDPR, CCPA, and other privacy regulations.

entries.title: Shipping Policy
entries.content: Standard shipping takes 5-7 business days (US only). Express shipping is available for 2-3 business days delivery. Free shipping is available on orders over $50. We ship to all 50 US states, Canada, and select international locations. Tracking information is provided with every order.

entries.title: Technical Support SLA
entries.content: Priority 5 (critical) issues: responded to within 1 hour. Priority 4 (high) issues: 4 hours. Priority 1-3: within 24 hours. We have a dedicated engineering team for critical outages. All technical issues include root cause analysis and follow-up.

entries.title: Billing and Payment Policy
entries.content: We accept Visa, Mastercard, American Express, Discover, and PayPal. Subscriptions auto-renew monthly unless cancelled. Invoices are available in your account under Billing History. All payments are processed securely through PCI-compliant processors. Billing inquiries should be sent to billing@example.com.
